reviews.title: A possible replacement for Mint, if they finish developing...
reviews.review: I really want to give 5 stars as Wallet is so close to solving the agonizing dilemma of switching from Mint. I have compared with PocketGuard (lifetime purchase) and Simplify (subscription), as well as Piere and Empower (free). Wallet might be the most similar UI to Mint, with a really nice Dashboard and Statistics (also a lifetime purchase that is 1/3 of PocketGuard). Notable features of Wallet: an iPad specific App!
